buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses MANDATORY TERMS & ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. The offer(s), resultant Contract(s) and all supporting documents shall be e-signed online by the re spective authorized User/Functionary of the Seller and Buyer. The e-signature shall have legal vali dity as per the Information Technology Act, 2000 and amendments thereto. No ink-signed copies of such documents shall be required, wherever permissible under applicable Government instructi ons. 2. The prices quoted by the Seller shall be all-inclusive, including all applicable taxes, duties, levies, charges and other statutory liabilities, as applicable. Any statutory variation during the contract p eriod shall be dealt with as per applicable Government rules and provisions of the Contract. 3. All services provided under the Contract(s) shall conform to the prescribed specifications, scope o f work and quality standards. The Seller/Service Provider shall promptly rectify any errors, deficien cies or shortcomings in the Social Media content, creative, posts and campaigns without any addit ional cost to the Department. 4. The Buyer/Consignee shall have the final right to accept or reject any Social Media content, creati ve, post, campaign or other deliverable without assigning any reason. No claim or compensation a rising from such rejection shall be entertained. 5. The Seller/Service Provider should have adequate experience in providing Social Media Managem ent and Digital Communication Services to District/State-level Government Departments, Govern ment Organizations, PSUs or similar organizations and shall submit relevant Work Orders, Experie nce Certificates or Completion Certificates as documentary evidence. 6. The Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) prescribed by the Buyer shall form an integral part of th e tender/contract and shall be duly complied with by the Seller/Service Provider. 7. The Seller/Service Provider shall mandatorily submit sample Social Media designs/ creatives alon g with a detailed 30-day Social Media Micro-Planning for demonstration (Demo) prior to bidding. S ubmission of the same is mandatory and shall be evaluated and approved by the IEC Department/ Buyer. 8. The Seller/Service Provider should have Cumulative turnover of not less than ₹70 Lakhs of the las t three financial years and shall submit audited financial statements/CA-certified turnover certifica tes as documentary evidence. 9. The Seller/Service Provider shall provide the contracted services within the stipulated time period . Any delay in provision of services shall attract penalty as per applicable Government rules, guide lines and provisions of the Contract. 10. The Buyer/Consignee shall have the right to modify, reduce, increase or cancel the Work Order, i n whole or in part, even after issuance, as per administrative requirements and applicable rules. T he decision of the Buyer/Consignee in this regard shall be final and binding. 11. The quantity/requirement of Social Media Management and Digital Communication Services may be increased or decreased as per the requirement of the Department at the finalized tender rates and as per applicable rules. 12. The Agency/Seller should be empanelled with the Directorate General of Information and Public Relations (DGIPR), Government of Maharashtra, in accordance with Government Resolution dated 23/11/2023 and shall submit valid documentary proof of such empanelment.

13. The Seller/Service Provider shall comply with the “No Advance Payment” policy of the Departmen t. Payment shall be released only against satisfactory provision of services and submission of requ isite documents, subject to applicable rules and availability of funds. . 3.
